import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, r2_score
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor

# Regression

TRAIN_FILE = '/content/jakarta_house_train.csv'
TEST_FILE = '/content/jakarta_house_test.csv'
FEATURES = ['carport', 'land_area', 'building_area']
TARGET = 'price'

train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_FILE)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_FILE)

train_df = train_df[FEATURES + [TARGET]].dropna()
test_df = test_df[FEATURES + [TARGET]].dropna()

print(train_df.head())

print(train_df.tail())

# untuk melihat statistical details
print(train_df.describe())

# check-in k histogram for continuous columns
train_df.hist(figsize=(12, 8))
plt.show()

# check correlation coef
df_num = train_df.select_dtypes(include=['number'])
print(df_num.corr())

print(train_df.isnull().sum())

## check categorical attributes

df_X = train_df[FEATURES]
df_y = train_df[TARGET]
cats = df_X.select_dtypes(include=['object', 'bool']).columns
print(cats)

X_train = train_df[FEATURES].astype(float).values
y_train = train_df[TARGET].astype(float).values
X_test = test_df[FEATURES].astype(float).values
y_test = test_df[TARGET].astype(float).values

raw_notebook_cells.source: ## Linear Regression

reg = LinearRegression()
reg.fit(X_train, y_train)

print('coef of determination training ', reg.score(X_train, y_train))
print('coef of determination testing ', reg.score(X_test, y_test))

print('coefficient')
print(reg.coef_)
print('intercept')
print(reg.intercept_)

print('prediction')
y_pred = reg.predict(X_test)
print(y_pred[:10])
print('real value')
print(y_test[0:10])

mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred)
rmse = np.sqrt(mse)
r2 = r2_score(y_test, y_pred)

print('rmse : ', rmse)
print('r2 :', r2)

data1 = pd.Series(y_test[:50].ravel())
data2 = pd.Series(y_pred[:50].ravel())

df_new = pd.concat([data1, data2], keys=['real values', 'predicted values'], axis=1)
df_new.plot(kind='bar', figsize=(15, 3))

plt.title("Linear regression")
plt.xlabel('Sample i')
plt.ylabel('House Price')
plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, r2_score
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor

# Decission Regression 5 variabel: carport, land area, dan building area

TRAIN_FILE = '/content/jakarta_house_train.csv'
TEST_FILE = '/content/jakarta_house_test.csv'
FEATURES = ['carport', 'land_area', 'building_area', 'bed_rooms', 'bath_rooms']
TARGET = 'price'

train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_FILE)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_FILE)

train_df = train_df[FEATURES + [TARGET]].dropna()
test_df = test_df[FEATURES + [TARGET]].dropna()

print(train_df.head())

print(train_df.tail())

# untuk melihat statistical details
print(train_df.describe())

# check-in k histogram for continuous columns
train_df.hist(figsize=(12, 8))
plt.show()

# check correlation coef
df_num = train_df.select_dtypes(include=['number'])
print(df_num.corr())

print(train_df.isnull().sum())

## check categorical attributes

df_X = train_df[FEATURES]
df_y = train_df[TARGET]
cats = df_X.select_dtypes(include=['object', 'bool']).columns
print(cats)

X_train = train_df[FEATURES].astype(float).values
y_train = train_df[TARGET].astype(float).values
X_test = test_df[FEATURES].astype(float).values
y_test = test_df[TARGET].astype(float).values
dt = DecisionTreeRegressor(max_depth=10, random_state=42)
dt.fit(X_train, y_train)

print('coef of determination training ', dt.score(X_train, y_train))
print('coef of determination testing ', dt.score(X_test, y_test))

print('prediction')
y_pred = dt.predict(X_test)
print(y_pred[:10])
print('real value')
print(y_test[0:10])

mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred)
rmse = np.sqrt(mse)
r2 = r2_score(y_test, y_pred)

print('rmse : ', rmse)
print('r2 :', r2)

data1 = pd.Series(y_test[:50].ravel())
data2 = pd.Series(y_pred[:50].ravel())

df_new = pd.concat([data1, data2], keys=['real values', 'predicted values'], axis=1)
df_new.plot(kind='bar', figsize=(15, 3))

plt.title("DT regression")
plt.xlabel('Sample i')
plt.ylabel('House Price')
plt.show()
